Name: Blueprint
Author: SetsunaR
Description:
[heading]
[quote][size=3][i]Inspired by Minecraft’s Litematica [/i][/size][/quote][b][size=5]Capture Blueprints[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3]Capture a rectangular area, individual tiles, or multiple overlapping areas.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Use subtractive selection to remove parts from a captured area.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Save flooring, fences, furniture, machines, sprinklers, and tabletop items.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Optionally capture trees, crops, buildings, and machine products.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=5]Preview and Build[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3]Preview blueprints as transparent projections before building.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Move projections with the on-screen controls or arrow keys.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Choose Fill Only, Replace Conflicts, or Strict Restore building mode.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]View conflicts in red and optionally display the full captured area.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Use nearby chests as material sources, with a configurable search range.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Enable Creative Mode to build without consuming items.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=5]Organize Blueprints[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3]Search blueprints by name or note.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Favorite, rename, annotate, categorize, delete, and reorder blueprints.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Drag blueprints across pages to create a custom order.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Import and export blueprints as JSON files.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Share a blueprint copy with another online player who has the mod installed.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=5]Materials and Dependencies[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3]View the required items and compare them with available materials.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Identify specific flooring, fences, machines, and other placeable items.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]See which additional mods a blueprint requires.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Optionally include products currently displayed by processing machines.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=5]Thumbnail View[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3]Right-click a blueprint to open its interactive thumbnail.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Scroll to zoom and drag to move around large blueprints.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Show or hide trees, crops, buildings, and machines separately.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]See warnings for modded objects whose textures cannot be loaded.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=5]Interface Settings[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3]Choose Vanilla, Compact, or Dark panel style.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Set the interface scale from 0.50× to 1.50×.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Enable partitioned rendering to improve performance with large blueprints.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Change settings through Generic Mod Config Menu or[/size]

[code]config.json[/code][/*]
[/list][size=6][b]
[size=6]Install:[/size][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=6][b]How to use:[/b][/size]
[u]Press "L"[/u]
